hook.name: AutoExitHook
hook.description: An owner-managed hook that maintains three tick-range liquidity positions (lower, middle, upper) around a configured price band. Rebalancing (removing stale positions, optionally swapping tokens, and redeploying liquidity) is triggered manually by the owner via triggerRebalance() or updateConfig(); the afterSwap-triggered rebalance is commented out in this deployment.
